status: All11 source recoveries scored/exported/reimported; serialization and full-skin parity pass. Motion quality remains explicitly research/rework.
known_control_protocol: Exact source timestamps and original coordinate frame; no Procrustes, root shift or retiming. Report all51 nodes and visible50 chain separately because fittedLUMBAR absorbs invisibleMOTION translation.
representation_floor: Original SCAPULA translations cannot be reproduced by the one-translating-root rotation-only fitter: native-to-representable maxjoint10.7mm K0/23.4mm C07. NativeGT and projected oracle remain distinct from predictions.
h3_protocol: No original generation camera or 3D motion ground truth. Camera-specific training uses only synthetic random-pose original-rig renders; estimated-camera-lock uses same saved reading without new training.
